cites: a request envelope with no signature member at all. Section 10 makes a signature REQUIRED in ACS-Core and the error table defines SIGNATURE_INVALID for a required signature that is missing, while request-envelope.json lists no signature among its required members and section 10.1 calls signatures field-optional, so an implementation that validates the schema and verifies only the signatures it finds admits this envelope. The members above all carry a signature, which is why none of them could see that.

requirementText.sentence: canonical input is REQUIRED in ACS-Core
